## 更新内容

### 歌词匹配

- 标题对不上时用歌词反查：网易云按标题搜不到，或结果与 Cider 歌词重合不足 60% 时，从 Cider 歌词中挑出独特长句搜索网易云，时长相差 3 秒内且内容重合达标才采用。Apple Music 用英文名、其他平台用日文名的歌曲（例如 `Racing Into The Night` → 夜に駆ける）现在也能找到歌词。
- 通过 ISRC 查原文标题：解析 Cider 返回的 `isrc`，依次查询 Deezer 与 MusicBrainz，把原文标题作为搜索别名，与日区商店名称并行查找。
- 匹配更宽容：比对前先繁转简；双方时长相近时忽略 feat.、Remaster 等不影响歌词的标记（Live、Remix、Acoustic 仍需精确匹配）；多位艺人按集合比对。
- 拒收错歌：Cider 有可比对歌词、外部候选内容明显不符时直接丢弃，不再显示错歌，也不借用错歌的翻译。
- 缓存与限流：同一首歌的解析结果会缓存；网易云限流时冷却 2 分钟，不再反复请求。

### 托盘菜单

- 托盘右键菜单外观接近 Windows 11 原生菜单：圆角悬停高亮、分隔线内缩，字号由 13 调为 12。
- 菜单一角贴住光标展开，空间不足时向左或向上翻转，不再与光标隔出一段任务栏高度。

## 安装与升级

下载 `Lyrider_1.5.2.0_x64.msix` 和 `Lyrider.cer`，仅支持 Windows 11 x64。首次安装前，将证书导入当前用户的“受信任人”存储，再安装 MSIX：

```powershell
Import-Certificate -FilePath .\Lyrider.cer -CertStoreLocation Cert:\CurrentUser\TrustedPeople
Add-AppxPackage .\Lyrider_1.5.2.0_x64.msix
```

已有版本使用同一证书签名时，可直接安装新 MSIX 升级。安装包包含 .NET、Windows App SDK 运行时和中英文资源。

## 验证

- 逻辑及服务测试（Release）：350/350 通过（新增 17 项歌词匹配测试，更新托盘菜单定位测试）。
- 真实 API 探测：`Truth In Lies`、`Racing Into The Night`、`crossing field`、`七里香`、`Old Town Road (feat. Billy Ray Cyrus) [Remix]` 均找到正确歌词，同一首歌第二次命中缓存。
- 托盘菜单预览为离屏渲染。歌词匹配未接上 Cider 在 App 内实机运行，托盘菜单的实机弹出位置也未确认。

相关 Pull Request：[#29 托盘菜单对齐 Win11 原生样式](https://github.com/Ayor1337/Lyrider/pull/29)、[#30 外部歌词匹配召回与准确度提升](https://github.com/Ayor1337/Lyrider/pull/30)。

完整变更：[v1.5.1...v1.5.2](https://github.com/Ayor1337/Lyrider/compare/v1.5.1...v1.5.2)

## Changes in English

### Lyrics matching

- Lyrics-based lookup: when a NetEase title search finds nothing, or its result overlaps less than 60% with Cider's lyrics, distinctive lines from Cider's lyrics are used to search NetEase. A candidate is accepted only if its duration is within 3 seconds and its content matches. Songs titled in English on Apple Music but in Japanese elsewhere (e.g. `Racing Into The Night` → 夜に駆ける) now find lyrics.
- ISRC aliases: the `isrc` from Cider is looked up on Deezer, then MusicBrainz, and the original-language title is used as a search alias alongside the Japanese storefront name.
- More tolerant matching: Traditional Chinese is converted to Simplified before comparison; feat. and Remaster tags are ignored when durations are close (Live, Remix, and Acoustic still require an exact match); multiple artists are compared as a set.
- Wrong songs are rejected: when Cider has comparable lyrics and an external candidate clearly differs, it is discarded and its translation is not borrowed.
- Caching and rate limiting: resolved lyrics are cached per song, and NetEase rate limiting triggers a 2-minute cooldown.

### Tray menu

- The tray context menu now looks closer to the native Windows 11 menu: rounded hover highlights, inset separators, and 12pt text instead of 13pt.
- The menu opens with a corner at the cursor and flips left or up when there is not enough room, without a taskbar-height gap from the cursor.

### Installation and verification

Download `Lyrider_1.5.2.0_x64.msix` and `Lyrider.cer` for Windows 11 x64. For a first installation, import the certificate into the current user's Trusted People store using the commands above, then install the MSIX. Existing installations signed with the same certificate can upgrade directly.

All 350 logic/service tests passed in Release. Live API probes found the correct lyrics for the songs listed above, with the second lookup served from cache. The tray menu previews are off-screen renders. Lyrics matching was not run inside the app against a live Cider, and the tray menu's on-screen position was not checked on a running app.

Full changelog: [v1.5.1...v1.5.2](https://github.com/Ayor1337/Lyrider/compare/v1.5.1...v1.5.2)
